overview.description: The completeness fallacy: waiting for the data that would make the decision obvious. In a startup that data arrives after the decision was needed, or never.
objectives: Decide at the point where more information stops being worth its delay
Tell reversible decisions from unwindable ones and spend your deliberation accordingly
Know when to listen to advice and when to ignore it
prerequisites: Orientation: how to read this tree

steps.intro: The completeness fallacy: waiting for the data that would make the decision obvious. In a startup that data arrives after the decision was needed, or never.
instructions: List every decision you are currently deferring.
Mark each reversible or not. Make every reversible one today.
For each unwindable one, write what specific evidence would settle it and how you will get it.

submission.description: No named deliverable. Work the steps and keep the notes with the module in Homeroom.
